translationRepairs: In 1855 he served under Grand Secretary He Chun in the recovery of Luzhou and was promoted to district magistrate.
In 1855 he served under Provincial Military Commander He Chun in the recovery of Luzhou and was promoted to district magistrate.
提督 is the provincial military command, not the civil Grand Secretary office. The proposed correction accurately identifies He Chun's title.
In the fifth year, he followed Grand Secretary He Chun in recovering Luzhou and was promoted to district magistrate.
In the fifth year, he followed Provincial Military Commander He Chun in recovering Luzhou and was promoted to district magistrate.
The literal field makes the same office error: 提督 is Provincial Military Commander, not Grand Secretary.
When rebels besieged Baoqing, he marched to its relief; allied forces fought them off in a series of battles, and he was given the Mongol title Erde Muturu.
When rebels besieged Baoqing, he marched to its relief; allied forces fought them off in a series of battles, and he was given the title E'erdemu Baturu.
額爾德木巴圖魯 is the honorific E'erdemu Baturu. The existing 'Erde Muturu' incorrectly divides and corrupts the title.
When the main army captured Jiujiang, his merit earned him a place on the register as provincial military commander.
When the main army captured Jiujiang, his merit earned him a place on the register as regional commander (zongbing).
總兵 is a regional commander (zongbing), distinct from 提督, the provincial military commander.
For repeated victories Qingji received the title Ganyong Baturu, was made provincial military commander, and given provincial commander rank.
For repeated victories Qingji received the title Ganyong Baturu, was promoted to regional commander (zongbing), and was given the rank of provincial military commander (tidu).
擢總兵加提督銜 distinguishes promotion to zongbing from the added rank of tidu; the existing English collapses the two offices.
Jichang and provincial commander Cheng Daji routed him, retook Huoshan, and Jichang received provincial commander rank.
Jichang and regional commander Cheng Daji routed him, retook Huoshan, and Jichang received the rank of regional commander (zongbing).
Both 總兵 and 總兵銜 refer to the zongbing office or rank, not the higher provincial 提督 command.
In the tenth month he fought the Nian at Runing, stormed Pingyu Stockade, took the rebel chief Chen Wen alive, and was entered on the rolls as provincial commander.
In the tenth month he fought the Nian at Runing, stormed Pingyu Stockade, took the rebel chief Chen Wen alive, and was entered on the rolls as regional commander (zongbing).
總兵記名 means being entered on the rolls for appointment as zongbing, not as provincial commander.

When Tingzhou and Liancheng fell in turn, Wencha hurried back, routed the rebels at Jinji Ridge, ambushed them along the river line, retook Liancheng, and pressed on to capture Tingzhou; he was entered on the rolls as provincial commander.

When Tingzhou and Liancheng fell in turn, Wencha hurried back, routed the rebels at Jinji Ridge, ambushed them along the river line, retook Liancheng, and pressed on to capture Tingzhou; he was entered on the rolls as regional commander (zongbing).
The source again has 總兵記名, registration for a zongbing post rather than the 提督 office.
When provincial commander Qin Ruhu attacked Chuzhou the rebels abandoned the city; Jinyun fell as well, and Wencha was appointed provincial commander of the Funing garrison.
When regional commander Qin Ruhu attacked Chuzhou the rebels abandoned the city; Jinyun fell as well, and Wencha was appointed commander of the Funing garrison (zongbing).
秦如虎 and Wencha both hold 總兵 posts here; the proposal correctly renders the office and the Funing garrison command.

He pressed the attack on the rebel stronghold at Jiaxiu Pavilion, recovered old Longli district, was appointed deputy commander of the Duyun garrison, and was entered on the rolls as provincial commander.

He pressed the attack on the rebel stronghold at Jiaxiu Pavilion, recovered old Longli district, was appointed deputy commander of the Duyun garrison, and was entered on the rolls as regional commander (zongbing).
總兵記名 is registration as a regional commander (zongbing), not as a provincial military commander.

In 1856, when Grand Secretary He Chun's assault on the rebel fort at Sanhe stalled, Wende volunteered to go in alone with a surrender proclamation; defectors came over one after another, and Sanhe fell.

In 1856, when Provincial Military Commander He Chun's assault on the rebel fort at Sanhe stalled, Wende volunteered to go in alone with a surrender proclamation; defectors came over one after another, and Sanhe fell.
提督 identifies He Chun as Provincial Military Commander. Grand Secretary would require 大學士 and is unsupported here.
In 1865 Governor-General Luo Chongguang ordered him to raise Hunan braves for operations toward Libo and Dushan.
In 1865 Governor-General Lao Chongguang ordered him to raise Hunan braves for operations toward Libo and Dushan.
The governor-general's name is written 勞崇光, Lao Chongguang; Luo is a mistransliteration.
In 1871 he was made provincial commander of the Weining garrison and led the campaign against the Guzhou Miao.
In 1871 he was made regional commander (zongbing) of the Weining garrison and led the campaign against the Guzhou Miao.
威寧鎮總兵 is the zongbing command of the Weining garrison, not a provincial 提督 appointment.
